text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After completing a training session with
Inari
One...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
We done already? Ya sure you're not
missin'
something? I'm still burstin' with
energy!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, Boss! Don't be stingy. Lemme run
some
more!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, Boss! Don't be stingy. Lemme run
some
more!
choice_data_list: これ以上はオーバーワークになるから……

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What're you talkin' 'bout? Us Edo folk
don't
waste time savin' our leg strength
for tomorrow!
choice_data_list: これ以上はオーバーワークになるから……

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Inari! Inari! Are you still running?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oh! Hey there, Turbo. Wazzup?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I've still got energy to burn, so I wanna
run some
more!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
It feels amazing to run until you're
exhausted! Just
the other day, I ran so
hard that I fell asleep as
soon as I
stopped!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Fussin' over semantics is a bad
look! Floor it
till you run outta gas! Ya
got some real Edo spirit,
Turbo!
choice_data_list: それは気絶したのでは……

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'll join ya for a li'l run! I can't sit quietly
lettin' you
be the only stylin' racer here!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: All right! I knew you'd come 'round!
choice_data_list: こちとらトレーナーとして黙ってらんねえ！

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: All right, Turbo! Let's run, partner!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: You betcha! Let's run, run, RUN!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Turbo! Don't just run off by
yourself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One happily runs with Twin Turbo
until the
sun falls below the horizon.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Ya know what? I respect that!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Ya know what? I respect that!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The way ya stay true to yourself is really

somethin' else! Ya must really believe in
your
ideas!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ya got guts, so I'll let ya off the hook!
Let's wrap
up today's special trainin'
session!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you're not gonna run more? Aw, I
was
looking forward to a real match!
That sucks!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
How 'bout we swing by a sweets shop
and have a
dango eatin' contest instead?
Nothin' beats sweet
treats when you're
feelin' tired!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: You're on! I accept your challenge!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Haha, you're as adorable as ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One speaks with a satisfied look on
her face
as she heads out with Twin
Turbo.
